text:
anya: Heads-up — want to propose rebucketing our remaining work into 3 dependency buckets (A/B/C) and shift MVP date by one week. Reason: infra perf regression + acme pilot needs stability.

sam: What's in A vs B vs C? can we avoid shifting release if we move some items to C?

anya: A = must ship for pilot (SSO, tenant routing fixes, model pinning). B = nice-to-have for v1 (embeddings cache tuning, UX polish). C = stretch (admin analytics, quota UI).

mike: Quick reality check: our infra perf regression is on serving runtime LRU patch — latency p95 up from 120ms to 310ms under steady traffic. Until that's mitigated, we can't guarantee pilot SLA.

leslie: @mike logs: deploy-bot pushed the rollback log: 
```deploy-bot: rollback at 2026-03-21T15:12:03Z - patch revert #4821``` 
we're still seeing KV cache miss storms.

sam: If A must include model pinning, that's a non-trivial infra change. Can we scope model pinning minimal (config flag + fallback) instead of full rollout? That might save 2 days.

anya: Yeah propose a minimal model-pinning: config flag per-tenant + automatic fallback to latest-stable. If we do that + emergency CPU autoscale it could keep the pilot happy.

leah: From design: we can hide the pinning UI behind an 'advanced' toggle for pilot tenants. No need to polish it for MVP.

mike: Autoscale note: current autoscaler scale-up ttfb is 60s. We can add a temporary aggressive scale policy for the pilot's dedicated pool — needs on-call sign-off.

leslie: On-call is fine with a temporary policy. But we need a rollback playbook and a canary plan. If we can canary to 3 pilot tenants, that buys confidence.

anya: New proposed plan (quick):
- Move admin analytics + quota UI to C
- Keep embeddings cache tuning in B but ship basic cache for MVP
- Implement minimal model-pinning + fallback in A
- Add aggressive autoscale for pilot dedicated pool + canary to 3 tenants
- Shift MVP date by 7 days, keep v1 launch target same

Can everyone ack if this is acceptable? :eyes:

sam: ack for dev constraints. I'll size model-pinning minimal at 2 dev-days, autoscale config 1 dev-day, canary orchestration 1 dev-day.

leah: ack for design approach.

leslie: I'll draft rollback playbook and monitoring dashboard. target ETA EOD tomorrow.

anya: Thanks — will update the milestone tracker and ping sales/CS about pilot expectation shift. @mike please open the infra PR and tag me.

mike: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/r/infra/PR-4892 — minimal pin + autoscale. cc @anya :+1:

deploy-bot: CI failed on infra PR-4892: flaky e2e - logs at https://ci.redwood.ai/4892/logs

sam: I'll triage the flaky test. if it's quick we may keep the original date, but assume the 7-day wiggle for communication.

anya: Cool. I'll update the public milestone doc and run a short sync tomorrow 10am PT. Thanks all. :rocket:
